title: Not enough hooks.
text: Not enough hooks.. The shamrocks were fine but there are not enough hooks to hang them.  I live in a rural area and avoid town due to covid.  I will now have to go.  I could have bought the decorations in town and not have to wait to complete my project.  Very inconvenient.
